bullets.text: In Arambakkam, Thiruvallur, a woman attempted suicide with her children demanding the return of her second husband, and the office should monitor the case.
In Thiruttani, a gang entered a house and hacked a girl's father to death for refusing a marriage proposal, requiring police follow-up.
Four devotees were injured after a statue collapsed at the Thiruttani Murugan temple, and authorities must ensure structural safety at religious sites.
Minister Dr. K.G. Arunraj stated that TVK victory in the by-election is certain, and the office should note these political remarks.
In western suburbs like Porur and Iyyappanthangal, clogged canals raised waterlogging concerns ahead of the monsoon, requiring clearance work.
GCC asked NHAI to clear Cooum obstructions by October 15 for the Maduravoyal project, and the office should track progress.
Hindi signboards on Poonamallee High Road near Koyambedu Metro sparked public shock, and the office should watch language policy compliance.
Thiruttani Municipality announced a Rs 5,000 fine for littering in public places to ensure cleanliness under the solid waste management plan.
Collector Kavitha announced November 15 as the deadline for paddy crop insurance, and the district team should spread awareness.
The Tiruvallur district administration tightened surveillance on paddy movement to stop traders from illegally using direct procurement centres.
The Government of Keralam renamed its IT department to the Department of Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence and Electronics.
Telangana IT Minister D. Sridhar Babu pitched a global capability centre hub at the REACH 2026 conclave, emphasizing skill-centric curricula.
Industry reports expect India's data center capacity to reach 6 GW by 2030, creating diverse non-software job demands.
A delegation of Tamil Nadu ministers is visiting Kerala to meet leader V.D. Satheesan amid by-election contexts, and the office should monitor developments.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Chennai on October 11 to launch metro rail services and open an Ilaiyaraaja music learning center at IIT Madras.
